headline: 15% instant off with Amex Corporate Card (max ₹5000)
description: 15% instant discount on select products at Tata CLiQ Luxury when you pay with an American Express Corporate Card. Minimum transaction 15000 rupees (excl. taxes); maximum discount 5000 rupees. Once per card per week. Excludes many luxury watch/jewellery brands, Apple, Samsung and electronics.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in on luxury.tatacliq.com or the Tata CLiQ Luxury app.
2. Add eligible products (min 15000 rupees, excl. taxes) to cart.
3. Apply code AXCORPTCL and pay with an American Express Corporate Card.
terms: Amex Corporate Cards only; select products; min 15000 rupees; max 5000 rupees off; once per card per week; cannot be combined with other offers; India only.
verified_note: ✓ Official Tata CLiQ Luxury T&C page (checked 2 Oct 2026)

headline: 10% off up to ₹100 with eligible Visa card
